name: Vehicle Dynamics
summary: How vehicles accelerate, brake, corner and ride: tyre mechanics, handling models, suspension kinematics and stability control.

topics.name: Tyre mechanics: slip, cornering stiffness and the Pacejka Magic Formula
Longitudinal dynamics: traction, braking and load transfer
Lateral dynamics: bicycle model, understeer/oversteer, steady-state cornering
Suspension kinematics and compliance; roll centres
Ride dynamics: quarter-car and half-car models and ride comfort
Vehicle stability control, ABS and traction control
